verdict.rationale: Base44's core value proposition is natural-language app building: users describe what they want and AI generates/updates code, design, and components (docs-31, docs-33), with AI agents and chat modes extending this to in-app actions, workflows, and tool connections (docs-6, docs-43, docs-45). Community reports corroborate that natural-language prompts produce functional apps (comm-4, comm-5, comm-6). Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of command reliability/complexity limits and more detail on failure modes of natural-language instructions beyond anecdotal HN reports.
